error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If x + 4 = 0 gives x = 4, the issue is not using the opposite value to make zero. This sign step reappears when finding roots from brackets.

hint_ladder.title: Plus equation
hint_ladder.prompt: Solving x + 4 = 0 asks what value of x makes the sum equal zero.

hint_ladder.title: Undo addition
hint_ladder.prompt: Undo adding 4 by subtracting 4 from both sides.

hint_ladder.title: Opposite sign
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is answering x = 4 because the number shown is 4. The zero balance needs the opposite sign.

hint_ladder.title: Zero-balance routine
hint_ladder.prompt: For x + a = 0, x must be -a so the two terms cancel. Apply that here; do not copy.

expected_solution_steps.diagnostic_sentence: This repair focuses on choosing the value that cancels +4 rather than repeating the visible number.
